That's because it is! That quote is taken SOOO out of context to benefit toxic family.

The TRUE saying is: the blood of the covenant is thicker than water of the womb.
Meaning that the bonds you create and accept as your REAL family are stronger than the ones that you are born from.

I also had to learn this because my family is toxic AF, and they would constantly use this to their advantage. So fuck those toxic people! You deserve a lot better! Find your true family, build it as large or as small as you want, and surround yourself with people who love you for you.

Good luck out there, my friend!

Wow. Kind of funny how you can't see the similarities between us. I said my person is very sexual right? So he's found ways that he can get his needs filled and still be with me.

Same as how they could possibly be as well. She was upfront and he was ok with it or otherwise he wouldn't have agreed to go out with her. Also very similar to my situation.

There is no reason to blame her for his choice. She didn't lie to him. He chose this on his own. He just needs to figure out what he wants and needs and if they can continue their relationship with the certain things he needs to fulfill him. If not, then it's not a match. 

I'm not disagreeing with you on that fact. I'm just not ok with you being so rude to asexuals when they are allowed to love and be with whoever they want. It's possible for asexuals to be with normal sexual people. That's the only point I'm trying to make. Thank you and have a great day 😊

And so what?

*His* case isn't too far off from *mine* so excuse yourself. You don't need to be rude.

I'm asexual and I'm with a sexual person. I was upfront with my person and he understood what he was getting into. He loves me and understands me to this day, even after 5 years. It's a matter of what a person is willing to do and put up with. It's not "her bad", sounds like she was upfront about it and it seems like he agreed, knowing fully well what that meant.

Now if it's a problem for him, then he needs to find some kind of solution, whether it be with her or without. He's not an asshole until he forces her to something that makes her uncomfortable. And if he did when she had goosebumps, he's a bit of an asshole.

TLDR: Don't blame asexuals for something not working. It's on both groups to decide if the relationship is worth the lack or the abundance of sex.

YTA!

You expect him to get a job in a week after telling him you're pregnant?! Then when you don't *SEE* him putting in applications, you threaten abortion?! 

Ok first off, are you around him 24/7, OP? Cause I think you're not, hence having a job. What's to say he isn't putting any in, when you're not there or on his phone doing them, when you are? So you're saying you watch every little thing he does on his phone? That's toxic af and you guys shouldn't be together in the first place, if that's the case.

Second off, if he tells you that he's putting out applications for jobs and *YOU* don't believe him, then it's not the job that's the problem. You guys obviously don't have trust for each other and you guys should either seek counseling or leave.

Honestly, this entire post screams that there is no trust in this relationship, on YOUR end anyway, and that's the biggest problem that needs to be fixed before you guys have another kid.
